name: Jiangsu Suzhou Rural Commercial Bank Co., Ltd
summary: Jiangsu Suzhou Rural Commercial Bank Co., Ltd provides various banking products and services in China. The company provides savings and demand, fixed deposit and withdrawal, lump-sum, flexible, call, and agreement deposits, as well as certificates of deposits; personal consumer, business, mortgage, and other loans; and financial and intermediate services. It also offers corporate finance, such as corporate wealth management, self-operated wealth management; specialty loans; and settlement and SME financing services, as well as debit, credit, and citizen cards.
